st: In Which We Meet Mr. Jones
d: When a strange parasite attaches itself to the internal organs of a dying agent, Agent Dunham rushes to Germany to meet with a prisoner who reveals details of a much larger threat.
Liv investigates the murder of a private eye who was stabbed in the head with an ice pick.
Liv and Clive investigate the death of an old school drag queen, which leads Liv to eat and shift into the queen's brain. Meanwhile, Ravi has a request for Major.
The human versus zombie war finally comes to a head. Rose McIver, Rahul Kohli, Malcolm Goodwin, Robert Buckley, David Anders, Aly Michalka and Bryce Hodgson also star.
In the series premiere, a medical resident turned zombie works in the coroner's office. With each brain she eats, she inherits the corpse's memories, helping her solve crimes.

st: Brother, Can You Spare A Brain?
d: Liv, Ravi and Clive work together to solve the mysterious death of a painter. After eating his brain, Liv finds herself consumed with passion. JUDY REYES (Scrubs) guest stars.
A victim turns out to be a sociopathic hit man responsible for the murder of a tech entrepreneur. Liv and Ravi dig deeper into a supposed zombie sighting. Major moves on.
Liv is surprised when Clive is quick to refuse her help in solving a murder, so Liv and Ravi investigate on their own. Meanwhile, Major begins searching for a roommate.
When a music prodigy is kidnapped, it's discovered that a sequence of flashing lights appeared at the abduction — which Walter links back to his bunkmate at St. Claire's Hospital.
While investigating a mystifying incident at Massive Dynamic, Olivia seeks to rid her consciousness of Agent Scott and Peter's past catches up with him.
While investigating a series of extraordinary bank robberies that defy the laws of physics, Walter realizes that the high-tech thieves are after something of his.
After shifty FBI Agent Loeb orchestrated Mr. Jones's otherworldly escape from a German prison and Olivia's alarming abduction, indications of a larger threat begin to emerge.
An outlaw smuggler and her alien companion are recruited by the Emperor of the Galaxy to rescue his son and destroy a secret weapon by the evil Count Zarth Arn.

In this mind-bending sci-fi thriller, 8 friends at a dinner party start experiencing strange and mysterious events on the night a comet is passing close to Earth. Soon it becomes clear that nothing and no one are what they appear.
A computer scientist-turned-serial killer has discovered an unconventional method of killing people — by liquefying their brains.
